text.div: POST /$import with an NDJSON body: each line stored as a write would be, ids kept; the answer is an OperationOutcome with the counts and the first refused lines.

name: Import
title: sazare $import
description: Store the resources of an NDJSON body (Content-Type: application/fhir+ndjson), one per line, each checked as any write is; the ids in the lines are kept. Lines that can't be stored are reported, the others stored. The answer is an OperationOutcome with the counts (the import-result extension) and the first refused lines as issues; 400 when none was stored.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: The outcome: counts in the import-result extension, refused lines as issues.
